title: CatalogSearchMissedPayload
description: Payload of `catalog.search.missed` version 1: a search found nothing. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`, because the search was not a partner's act; the payload carries the words as understood and where they were typed, never who typed them. Optional members are absent or `null` when they do not apply. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

words.description: The words as understood: lower case, accents folded, separated by single spaces.

service_area_id.description: The service area searched from, for a search across stores.

vertical_id.description: The Vertical the search was narrowed to.

location_id.description: The store, for a search inside one store.
